```yaml
name: Java Bulk CDK Base Publish

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Pants
        uses: pantsbuild/actions/init-pants@v10
        with:
          get-pants-version: '1.20.0'
          named-caches-hash: 'default'

      - name: Get changed connector metadata files
        id: changed-files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v46
        with:
          separator: ','
          files: 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/**/metadata.yaml'

      - name: Run tests for changed connectors
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files != ''
        run: |
          echo "Running tests for changed connectors"
          for file in ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files }}; do
            connector_dir=$(dirname "$file")
            echo "Testing $connector_dir"
            pants test $connector_dir
          done

      - name: Build Docker images for changed connectors
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files != ''
        run: |
          echo "Building Docker images for changed connectors"
          for file in ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files }}; do
            connector_dir=$(dirname "$file")
            image_name=$(basename "$connector_dir")
            docker build -t airbyte/${image_name}:latest $connector_dir
          done

      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Push Docker images
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files != ''
        run: |
          echo "Pushing Docker images"
          for file in ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files }}; do
            connector_dir=$(dirname "$file")
            image_name=$(basename "$connector_dir")
            docker push airbyte/${image_name}:latest
          done
```
